panels.title: 下行总流量

panels.description: 该设备总丢包率

targets.expr:
(
  sum(increase(ifInDiscards{job=~"$job", region=~"$region", brand=~"$brand", role=~"$role", instance=~"$device_ip"}[$__range]))
  +
  sum(increase(ifOutDiscards{job=~"$job", region=~"$region", brand=~"$brand", role=~"$role", instance=~"$device_ip"}[$__range]))
)
/
(
  sum(increase(ifHCInUcastPkts{job=~"$job", region=~"$region", brand=~"$brand", role=~"$role", instance=~"$device_ip"}[$__range]))
  +
  sum(increase(ifHCOutUcastPkts{job=~"$job", region=~"$region", brand=~"$brand", role=~"$role", instance=~"$device_ip"}[$__range]))
)
* 100

panels.title: 当前设备丢包率

panels.description: 该设备总错包率

targets.expr:
(
  sum(increase(ifInErrors{job=~"$job", region=~"$region", brand=~"$brand", role=~"$role", instance=~"$device_ip"}[$__range]))
  +
  sum(increase(ifOutErrors{job=~"$job", region=~"$region", brand=~"$brand", role=~"$role", instance=~"$device_ip"}[$__range]))
)
/
(
  sum(increase(ifHCInUcastPkts{job=~"$job", region=~"$region", brand=~"$brand", role=~"$role", instance=~"$device_ip"}[$__range]))
  +
  sum(increase(ifHCOutUcastPkts{job=~"$job", region=~"$region", brand=~"$brand", role=~"$role", instance=~"$device_ip"}[$__range]))
)
* 100
